metric_definitions.routing_frequency: Valid-token top-k assignments to an expert divided by all valid-token top-k assignments, computed independently per MoE layer.
metric_definitions.gate_mass: Sum of the selected routing coefficients actually applied by the model, divided by valid token count. For OLMoE norm_topk_prob=false, selected coefficients are not renormalized to sum to one.
metric_definitions.functional_contribution: Sum over valid routed tokens of the L2 norm of gate_weight times the individual expert output, divided by valid token count. This is an activation-magnitude proxy, not causal importance.
metric_definitions.normalized_vectors: Each nonnegative layer/domain expert vector divided by its sum.
